content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Automated ebook

The architecture behind automated ebook delivery using cryptocurrency is a game changer for digital creators. It eliminates reliance on conventional payment processors that impose high fees and operational restrictions. By using a sovereign commerce stack, creators can automate the entire process from payment confirmation to product delivery. This not only streamlines operations but also ensures that creators retain full ownership and control over their digital assets, promoting [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/financial-sovereignty-digital-creators-crypto-honest-side-side-24|COREMERCH guide to financial]] independence.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, the architecture utilizes free tools that integrate seamlessly to support automated transactions and digital product delivery. Using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, combined with backend logic through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, creators can manage their storefronts effectively. When a customer makes a crypto payment via NOWPayments, the system automatically verifies the transaction, triggering the delivery of the ebook or digital product. This process is efficient, cost-effective, and eliminates the need for third-party dependencies.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This architecture is specifically designed for digital creators operating in regions where traditional payment processors are either unavailable or prohibitively expensive. Creators of ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, and other digital products can benefit significantly from this setup. By utilizing a sovereign commerce stack, they can bypass the high fees charged by platforms like Gumroad, which takes 10% from every sale, compared to the 0.5% fee charged by NOWPayments. This difference can lead to substantial savings, allowing creators to focus on growth rather than excessive transaction costs.
Eliminate high platform fees and keep more of your earnings.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The sovereign commerce stack is composed of several key components that work in unison to create a robust selling platform. It includes hosting options like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, backend processing through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and order management via Supabase or Google Sheets. The final piece is NOWPayments, which facilitates cryptocurrency transactions efficiently and securely. Together, these components ensure that creators can deliver products automatically while maintaining full ownership and control over their sales.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Deploying your own automated ebook delivery system is straightforward. Start by selecting the appropriate hosting service, either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, and set up your site. Next, implement backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for order processing. Integrate NOWPayments to handle crypto transactions, and use Supabase or Google Sheets for order management. Finally, test the entire system to ensure seamless functionality before launching your store. For a comprehensive resource, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all necessary blueprints and templates for a successful deployment.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by utilizing a sovereign commerce stack that automates the entire process. By leveraging cryptocurrency payment processors like NOWPayments, you can retain ownership and control over your digital products. This approach eliminates high fees associated with traditional platforms and ensures efficient delivery of your products without dependency on third-party services.
Take control of your digital sales with automated delivery.

If you're looking to sell your digital downloads without platform fees, explore the Complete Builder Kit ($197) at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This kit provides you with all the blueprints and templates needed to establish a sovereign digital commerce stack and start generating revenue immediately.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
